1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25°C of __at least 10 cps__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, and wherein said MAAC comprises a polypeptide.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __the MAAC comprises an inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the MAAC comprises a polypeptide selected from the group consisting of an angiogenesis inhibitor and a receptor inhibitor.

14. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein is an angiogenesis inhibitor.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein comprises bevacizumab.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a hyaluronic acid.

21. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range from about 10,000 Daltons to about 2 million Daltons.

22. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 100,000 Daltons to about 1.5 million Daltons.

23. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 200,000 Daltons to about 1 million Daltons.

24. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of at least about 100 cps at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 1000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 10,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

27. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 70,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

28. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 200,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 250,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 300,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition comprises a condition of the posterior segment of the eye.

33. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is macular degeneration.

34. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is macular degeneration.

36. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said condition is macular degeneration.

37. (New) A pharmaceutical composition for intravitreal administration to treat macular degeneration comprising a polypeptide MAAC and a high viscosity hyaluronic acid carrier.
